panel: All 28 fixed requests; three saved endpoints B_STEP0, PLAIN3000, COUPLE3000
images: 56 three-column RAW/POST pages plus28 same-bound three-column pages, common scale and two depth views plus front/side central sections

required_per_output_fields.body_complete: YES/NO/UNCERTAIN: recognizable chair body with seat/back/support composition; open style is not automatically a missing part
required_per_output_fields.C_adopted_as_seat: YES/NO/UNCERTAIN: preserved blue C visibly serves the seat rather than being covered/replaced or left in an implausible body location
required_per_output_fields.obvious_fragments_or_folded_sheets: YES/NO/UNCERTAIN: visible detached or implausibly folded sheets; no claim of global self-intersection certification
required_per_output_fields.visible_cracks: YES/NO/UNCERTAIN: visible accidental gaps within an intended surface or join; design openings are not automatically cracks
required_per_output_fields.note: Concrete visible observation and limitations; do not fill labels from numerical metrics

identity: Each review names request, stage, model, actual image path/hash, reviewer and actual-view confirmation
limits: Central sections can miss off-plane defects. Image review does not certify exact connectivity, absence of CF/FF or watertightness. Source parent is not a unique target style.
selection: No choosing favorable requests, noises or checkpoints. Numerical and visual evidence are kept separately, with uncertainty retained.
